raw_sections.awards:
A C H I E V E M E N T S
Consistently delivered Project on time, demonstrating strong execution discipline and delivery excellence (2022-24). Managed complex transfer-conversion projects at Mastercard (2023), ensuring seamless customer migrations with no impact to live operations (2023). Recognized for impeccable support on PSD2 and Tokenization initiatives, contributing to regulatory compliance and enhanced customer experience (2022). Awarded Thredd Allrounder (2022), Thredd Star (2022), and Thredd Jira Hero (2019) for excellence in card payments domain expertise, client support, and issue resolution, and also got recognized for delivery excellence, collaboration, and customer impact (2020). Winner of the Trade Improvement Campaign at Yes Bank, recognized for process improvement and operational efficiency initiatives (2017).
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Team Lead - Payments TerraPay | May 2024 - Present
Working for Fintech’s Customer Success team, lead end-to-end delivery of products & services offered to TerraPay customers, managed overall business & account management for the customer supporting Pre-sales, Integration phase & post sales. Supported customers from Project initiation to operation handover ensuring customer’s success with the services offered conducting weekly calls, mitigating and managing escalations, resolving customer issues. If needed I ensured of initiation, tracking, managing and closing CRs. Owned client facing project delivery managing project scoping, planning, timelines, and delivery governance, enabling clear, action-oriented communication across customers and internal teams. Ensured technical readiness, commercial alignment, due diligence, security readiness, contracting, sandbox testing, pilots at customer end. Orchestrate cross-functional delivery across Compliance, Legal, Engineering, QA, and Operations, ensuring regulatory adherence and delivery milestones. Spearheaded end-to-end TerraPay customer onboarding and integration lifecycle, driving technical solutioning, API integrations, and go-live. Developed and maintained relationships at various level within customer origination ensuring quick outcome, faster resolution, project delivery and customer success. Act as the Card Payments Domain SME, providing strategic guidance in the projects, identifying critical defaults to enhance card processing and scalability. Establish and evolve project governance frameworks, owning project charters, MOMs, RAID logs, and milestone tracking to ensure alignment with objectives, risks, and success metrics. Acted as the primary client escalation point, maintaining CSAT scores above 95% across complex implementations Represent programs in executive forums, delivering clear status updates to CXOs, proactively managing expectations, and driving informed decision-making Leading an AI-driven knowledge initiative to develop an LLM-based solution that automatically generates fact sheets, consolidating regulatory requirements, transaction parameters, limits, and country-specific restrictions to streamline implementation, compliance readiness enhancing transaction success.
Senior Specialist, Implementations (Contractual role) Mastercard | July 2022 - May2024
Worked for MasterCard's Customer Implementation Service Team, Led client implementations for banks and financial organizations delivering Processor Conversions, Card migration, Portfolio conversion projects. I also handled projects across Issuing, Acquiring, and Payment Gateway platforms products. Owned the full implementation lifecycle from project kick-off to production go-live, consistently delivering 100% on-time implementations of all projects assigned while delivering 20+ projects. Applied strong project management practices to drive structured, customer-centric project execution; proactively managed risks and complex interdependencies, maintained MOMs and RAID logs, and defined mitigation strategies to ensure seamless delivery with minimal client impact. Gained deep understanding of Card Payments lifecycle; Authorization, Clearing, settlement, Chargeback, Tokenization and PCI-DSS (functional knowledge). While I also acquired Theoretical, functional and working knowledge in Dual & single messaging systems and along with transaction processing rules. Acted as the primary client-facing implementation lead, ensuring clear communication, stakeholder alignment, and responsible to maintain coordination between Issuing bank, Card processors and Internal teams for the project success. Showcased exceptional negotiation and risk mitigation skills. Developed and executed detailed implementation plans, owning scope, timelines, dependencies, and resource alignment across internal and client teams. Collaborated with product SMEs, technology teams, and testing teams to enable API integrations, transaction flows, and scheme certifications. Facilitated UAT coordination and certification readiness, ensuring solutions met Mastercard scheme rules, compliance standards, and client-specific requirements.
Implementations Analyst at Thredd Art Technologies & Software | January 2019 - July 2022
Worked for the Fintech's Implementations team performing phenomenally well in customer Implementation projects handling End-to-End Implementations of card-payments (Issuing) programs. Led end-to-end customer projects, managing scope, implementation plans, timelines, and multi-stakeholder coordination. Oversaw documentation, RAID Logs, platform configuration (Test & Production), and post-implementation support. Managing processor migration projects between payment scheme, Issuer, program manager, card manufacturer and multiple internal stakeholders Developed deep expertise in Thredd issuer processing platforms and played a key role in building the Implementations team at Art Technologies from the ground. Served as the primary contact for both internal and external stakeholders. Supported in formulating the UAT and SAT test cases again the issuer use case for quicker testing phase and shorter implementation TAT. Served as a subject matter expert in card operations, strengthening team understanding of day-to-day processes and enhancing domain capability across the card payments lifecycle. Drove continuous improvement, reducing change request TAT from24 hours to 10 hours optimizing platform, domain, and team processes.
Senior Officer Yes Bank | September 2016 - December 2018
Worked for corporate operation and service delivery team, heavily focusing on operations for business banking clients, government and high net-worth clients. Increased branch productivity from 38% to 168% and managed 100% productivity consistently for 12 months. Also, helped to achieve average branch compliance score of 90%. Operated corporate account on behalf of clients, processing banking transaction and trade finance/forex transactions, corporate account openings adhering to KYC-AML Regulations. Coordinating and managing deliverables with sales team, customer management, customer operations team, internal higher management and internal partners. Delivered excellent client support and built profitable client relationships, which resulted in gaining new clients as well as 60% increment in business volumes. Additionally responsible for branch audit risk & compliance, and customer experience.
Junior Accountant Souther Ispat and energy | August 2015 - September 2016
